<thought>Search the template catalog for retrosynthetic templates that break a halide (any aryl halide) and form a primary amine, then test each returned template on the target molecule to find the one that yields exactly the two precursors “COc1ccccc1N” and “Nc1cc([N+](=O)[O-])cc([N+](=O)[O-])c1O”. Once identified, return its mapped reaction SMILES and template ID.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "COc1ccccc1Nc1cc([N+](=O)[O-])cc([N+](=O)[O-])c1O",
    "functional_groups_broken": ["halide"],
    "functional_groups_formed": ["primary amines"],
    "limit": 20
}</action_input>
